title: Khan Academy and the Effectiveness of Science Videos
summary: Veritasium examines research suggesting science explainer videos like Khan Academy's make students feel they understand while tests show they have not learned, because misconceptions go unaddressed. It suggests how to partly fix this.
why: HN uses it in debates on video-based teaching and how confronting misconceptions helps learning, though some find its Khan Academy critique flawed.

quote.text: please watch the whole video because it explains one massive problem with video science lessons and how to partially fix the problem.
